title: Cannot click the friendly-unit target in the UI while the chain modal is open
expected: The chain overlay is `position:fixed; inset:0; align/justify center; z-index:1500` (public/css/gameplay.css:678-688) and while visible its `.chain-box` keeps `pointer-events:auto` (gameplay.css:694). The box is unscaled (~290px tall with one chain item: title/subtitle/72px item/priority/Pass button/hint) and centered on the viewport, whereas the board is a 1920x1080 logical canvas scaled down to fit; the player-base row sits directly beneath the vertically-centred battlefield row, so the lower part of the box (where .chain-pass-btn lives) lands over #player-base units. The only mitigation for board-pick prompts is `.chain-overlay.targeting { justify-content:flex-end }` (gameplay.css:1784-1790), but that class is toggled exclusively on #choiceOverlay in renderPendingChoiceModal (render/modals.js:32,41,179) — never on #chainOverlay. Client-side targeting mode entered from hand/sidebar (interactions.js:357-361 adds body.targeting-mode; banner text at interactions.js:321) has no CSS or JS that hides/moves #chainBox (targeting-mode rules at gameplay.css:1748-1750 only style cards). So with the chain open and Riposte's 'Choose a target' banner up, real clicks on base units under the box hit .chain-pass-btn/.chain-box instead of the .valid-target card.
observed: The 'The Chain' modal (#chainBox, z-index 1500) sits directly over the player's base zone; elementFromPoint at the unit's center returns .chain-pass-btn, and a real click on the unit times out. Only a synthetic dispatched click (or executeMove) could complete targeting. Same after using the sidebar 'Play Spell Riposte' button.
